data.statement: For an illustrated textile, the strongest clean execution lets the product's real fixed wording do the stop-work while one restrained contextual object makes the room story product-specific. The reading room was prettier in isolation but interchangeable; the kitchen bowl turns this exact cat-and-cauldron threat into a narrative.
data.decision: Keep the kitchen banquette as the slot's only survivor, reject the reading room and ungenerated medieval-set concept, and make no revision call because the winner has no diagnosed truth, composition, or artifact weakness that would justify risking fidelity.
data.nextAction: Prepare the exact unique Arm A morning package, record the standing bounded-experiment approval for that package, run validators and the guarded production dry run, then publish no more than one Pin in this run.
